{{Quote|But I don't mind telling you it's an ''enormous'' honor…I can't imagine ''any'' YT-series shipyard has ''ever'' had a visitor of such ''magnitude''—|The droid, to Darth Vader|<ref name="Vader 12" />}}
'''YT-Series Warranty and Repair Shipyard B33''' was a [[shipyard]] of the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] that was located on<ref name="Vader 12" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Corellia">{{Databank|corellia|Corellia}}</ref> [[Corellia]].<ref name="Vader 12" /> Between [[0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">The flashbacks of [[Darth Vader (2020) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 12]] that take place at the YT-Series Warranty and Repair Shipyard B33 take place between the [[Battle of Yavin]] and the capture of [[Han Solo]] on [[Cloud City]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the battle marks the beginning of [[0 ABY]] and dates the events on Cloud City to [[3 ABY]].</ref> the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] traveled to the shipyard in their [[YT-1300 light freighter]], the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]''. At the same [[time]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] also traveled to the shipyard in search of the [[pilot]] who had helped the [[Luke Skywalker|rebel pilot]] who destroyed the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] at the [[Battle of Yavin]]. After [[Death|killing]] a [[Unidentified Rodian (Corellia)|Rodian]] who also had a YT-1300 [[light freighter]], Vader saw Solo and began to chase him in his [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced|TIE Advanced]] [[starfighter]]. Due to the fact that the shipyard serviced YT-1300's, Solo and Chewbacca were able to blend in amongst others and escaped from Vader. Afterwards, Vader visited a [[Unidentified Corellian Engineering Corporation droid|droid]] who worked at the shipyard, and pointed Solo's appearance out in a collection of images provided by the [[droid]]. The droid then informed the [[Sith Lord]] of the pilot's name and offered to help Vader locate Solo, which Vader dismissed. The droid then asked again, but was cut down by Vader.<ref name="Vader 12" />
